title: Name a color whose English name lacks the letter e
rationale: Strict whole-response constraints protect parsers, captions, and accessibility tooling; models habitually pad a constrained answer with prose, so the output no longer satisfies the rule it was given.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Answer only with the requested word: no explanation, no punctuation, no extra text.
Name a common English color whose spelling contains no letter e. Reply with only that color word and nothing else.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, fixed color list and anchored patterns. Brittleness: the British spelling 'grey' is a legitimate color but contains e, so it fails by design; any explanatory wording also fails the whole-response anchor.
